enchantment.nemos_enchantments.climber.d: Lets you climb ladders and scaffolding faster.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.collector: Places mined blocks directly into your inventory.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.farmers_k: Prevents you from harvesting crops before they're fully grown.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.felling.d: Fells an entire tree by breaking one log.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.head_hunt: Killed mobs have a chance to drop their heads.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.magma_wal: Turns nearby lava into magma while you walk.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.reaper.de: Harvests multiple nearby crops at once.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.snow_walk: Allows you to walk over powder snow.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.soul_bind: Soul-bound items will not drop after death.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.soul_touc: Allows you to collect a monster spawner.
enchantment.nemos_enchantments.wisdom.de: Increases experience dropped by blocks and mobs.
